Hi Jens, nothing has changed since November 10. Order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. Your Hammer Miner Thor P2 ships November 30, 2026. The Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA is on the same order and comes in the same box.

The P2 is waiting for the next batch of stock to reach our Netherlands warehouse. It ships from inside the EU, so there's no import VAT or duty to pay on delivery. You can follow that batch at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and we'll email you tracking as soon as it ships.
